nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: CI container image that layers Node.js 24 and Bun on top of the build/base image, detecting the CPU architecture at build time to fetch the matching linux-x64/arm64 Node tarball and enabling corepack. Published as ghcr.io/anomalyco/build/bun-node:24.04, the standard image for GitHub Actions jobs in this monorepo.
nodes.languageNotes: The BUN_VERSION build-arg is fed from the root package.json packageManager field by packages/containers/script/build.ts, keeping the image's Bun version in lockstep with the monorepo. A uname -m based arch mapping keeps a single Dockerfile valid for multi-platform buildx builds.
